title: Exact Dual-Ring, Bini-Interpolation, and Constructive Lean 4 Certificates for Deterministic Real Matrix-Product Verification Complexity
abstract: Chen Xiangle (arXiv:2611.34814v1, Nov. 2026) proves that any real arithmetic decision tree of cost s deciding y = T(u,v) for a bilinear map T implies border-rank(T) <= 30s, establishing that deterministic exact real matrix-product verification has the same arithmetic exponent omega_C as matrix multiplication and matching Omega(S^(omega_C/2)) white-box polynomial identity testing bounds. We provide an independent, unrefereed companion certification suite (DET-MATMUL-VERIF-CERT-1.0) comprising: (i) 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice); (ii) a zero-float Python verifier over exact Q and the dual ring Q[alpha,beta]/(alpha^2,beta^2) auditing Freivalds' soundness, the Baur-Strassen 30s rank chain, Bini's Laurent-truncation Lagrange interpolation, white-box PIT reductions, and the dense-quadratic Gram equivalence RJR^T=0 iff HJH=0; and (iii) 16 canonical JSON certificates and 29 unit/forgery/AST tests.
